After doing some CSS magic Link flairs have been added to the sub. Please use them!

The link flairs are:

  • MV - Music Video

  • PV - Promotional Video. Interchangeable with MV.

  • Announcement - For posts like this one. Only for posts from mods.

  • News - News articles related to Jpop artists and groups

  • Discussion - For posts asking about Jpop or about songs/artists. Anything that's not a song itself (besides news and announcements)

  • Live - for live performances of songs

  • Audio-Only - audio only songs.

If your post title includes any of these your post doesn't need to have flair added to it. If you post title doesn't include one of our tags please either flair it yourself or we'll do it for you.
